name: Short Cut Broccoli-Cheddar Soup with Chives & Toasted Pretzel Bun

instructions.primary_message: Transfer soup to a medium saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper to taste.

Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and place rack in the upper third of the oven. Split buns in half and arrange, cut-side up, on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 2-3 minutes. Spread buns with butter if desired. (Alternatively you can use a toaster.)
Wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces.
Divide soup between bowls. Top with chives and serve with toasted pretzel buns on the side. Enjoy!
